broker.name: Octa
broker.tagline: A conduct licence was not confirmed on the pages that loaded. Rules depend on where you live. Advertised leverage: Up to 1:1000.
broker.about: The Octa pages checked on 11 October 2026 do not state a founding year or one headquarters. Account names on its site include OctaTrader, MetaTrader 5, and MetaTrader 4. Platforms named there include OctaTrader, MetaTrader 5, MetaTrader 4, and Octa Global app. Those pages do not confirm a conduct licence we could list with a country and a regulator name. Minimum deposit is not a single number on the pages that loaded. The highest leverage figure taken from those pages is Up to 1:1000. Leverage increases losses as well as gains.
broker.regulators_note: The company behind an account depends on where you live. No regulator entry is listed because the pages that loaded did not confirm one.

broker.leverage_note: Leverage increases losses as well as gains, and you can lose more than you deposit. The highest figure on this card is the highest number this broker advertises. It is not the cap on every account. The cap depends on the company, the product and where you live.

other_fees.label: Minimum deposit
other_fees.note: The account comparison table says 25 USD for OctaTrader, MetaTrader 5 and MetaTrader 4. The same page says the first deposit minimum is about 25 USD depending on the payment method. A deposits article on the same site says the minimum in South Africa is 480 ZAR and in Nigeria is 30,000 NGN. Because it varies by payment method and country, no single number is stored.

other_fees.note: Comparison page says no deposit or withdrawal fees, and no fees on order executions if you make at least one trade a year.

_notes.fetch_notes: https://www.octa.com loaded a tablet-stand shop, not the broker. https://www.octafx.com returned HTTP 404. The broker site that loaded is https://www.octabroker.com. The homepage says 15 years on the market and does not state a founded year. The crypto page says it is a licensed and regulated broker with several licences, but no regulator name or licence number was on the pages fetched. Regulators is therefore an empty list. The deposits article was found via search and its minimums for South Africa and Nigeria are included only as a reason the minimum is not a single USD number.
_notes.company_details_not_listed: The introducing broker agreement defines the Company as Versustrategy Inc. That page does not give a registration number, country or address.
